text:
jess (product-design): Quick flag: the in-console help panel calls the server setting a 'model profile' but our docs and SDK call it 'model config'. New users are confused when following the UI walkthrough.
omar (docs): Ah, we changed the docs earlier to use 'model config' to match API payloads (model_config.name). Guess the UI copy wasn't updated.
lee (devex): Do we have a single source of truth for UI terms? I thought glossary.yml in repo was the canonical list.
nina (frontend): The help panel text is coming from i18n: ui.help.model_profile.title. We can change the key and ship a copy patch, but prefer to reference docs anchor from docLinkService rather than hardcoding URL.
harry (pm): We should standardize on 'model config' because it's how SDKs and API examples call it. Any blockers?
jess (product-design): agree with model config. Also, the "Learn more about model profiles" link in the panel points to /docs/#model-profiles which 404s. Docs used /docs/reference/model-configs.
omar (docs): I'll add a redirect for /docs#model-profiles -> /docs/reference/model-configs and add an explicit anchor. Can do a small docs PR today.
paul (support): We had two tickets where customers couldn't find the right docs because of that exact phrasing. Support replies copied the UI wording which made it worse.
qa-bot: QA note: the help panel doesn't announce updates to screen readers when toggled; visible change isn't keyboard-focusable.
a11y-bot: Accessibility: use role=dialog on the help panel, set aria-labelledby to the panel heading, move focus into the panel when opened, ensure Escape closes and focus returns. Also ensure links have meaningful text (avoid "click here").
nina (frontend): I'll switch the i18n key to ui.help.model_config.title and wire docLinkService for the 'learn more' href. Will include focus management per a11y-bot.
lee (devex): We should add a canonical_terms.json and expose it to docs + i18n build so teams can import canonical labels. I'll draft a small RFC on where to store it (repo vs glossary service).
omar (docs): Will wait for the canonical term before mass find/replace. Meanwhile I'll add anchor + redirect and update examples to call out both terms for a week: "model config (aka model profile)".
harry (pm): Action list: 1) docs: add anchor + redirect + short note about terms (omar) 2) frontend: change i18n key, use docLinkService, and add focus behavior (nina) 3) devex: propose canonical_terms location and expose in builds (lee) 4) support: temp KB message and customer-facing phrasing (paul) 5) design: quick copy tweak to panel to mention alias for 1 week (jess).
paul (support): I'll add KB snippet and a canned reply: "Model config (previously shown as 'model profile' in the Console) = API/model_config.name".
nina (frontend): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2891 (WIP) will include aria changes.
omar (docs): Tracking issue #4621. I'll tag docs-deploy once merged.
lee (devex): Scheduling a 20m sync to agree on canonical_terms and CI exposure.
jess (product-design): I'll post the updated panel copy and screenshot in the design thread for a quick sign-off.
a11y-bot: Reminder: include keyboard and screen reader acceptance steps in PR descriptions.
harry (pm): Nice quick wins. Let's close this after doc deploy + frontend patch are live. :slightly_smiling_face:
